## GET `/benchmarks`

Benchmarks of average stat values for a hero

Operation ID: `get_benchmarks`.

### SDK call

```ts
const { data, meta } = await client.get("/benchmarks", {
  query: { hero_id: 1 },
});
```

### Parameters

Path parameters: none.

#### Query parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hero_id` | `number` | Yes | Not specified | Hero ID Integer. |
| `bracket` | `number` | No | Not specified | Rank bracket from 1 (Herald) to 8 (Immortal) to benchmark against. Omit for matches of all ranks Integer. |
| `role` | `"core" \| "support"` | No | Not specified | Benchmark against cores or supports only, estimated from farm within each team. Can be combined with bracket. Omit for all roles |

### Success response

HTTP `200`; content type `application/json; charset=utf-8`. Success

The SDK resolves to `OpenDotaResult<Data>`. `data` has the shape: [`BenchmarksResponse`](../schemas.md#benchmarksresponse). `meta` is documented in [Response metadata](../client.md#results-and-metadata).

```ts
import type { ResponseData } from '@reino-doce/opendota-client';

type Data = ResponseData<"/benchmarks", "get">;
```
